en.title: The Elephant Who Stopped Pulling | Gajendra
en.description:
What do you do when your own strength is not enough?

Gajendra fought a crocodile for years. He only won when he stopped pulling and called out.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapters 2-4.
